description: Defines the ISocketsTrace interface for socket connection tracing, extending ILogger, with methods for logging connection events.

classes.name: ISocketsTrace
classes.description: An internal interface for socket tracing, extending ILogger, with methods to log various connection events.

methods.name: ConnectionReadFin
methods.description: Logs the event when a connection read has finished.

methods.name: ConnectionWriteFin
methods.description: Logs the event when a connection write has finished, with a reason.

methods.name: ConnectionError
methods.description: Logs a connection error with an associated exception.

methods.name: ConnectionReset
methods.description: Logs the event when a connection is reset.

methods.name: ConnectionPause
methods.description: Logs the event when a connection is paused.

methods.name: ConnectionResume
methods.description: Logs the event when a connection is resumed.
